content.question: Match each sparse representation with its key property.

answer.One-hot: A single 1 per word; all word vectors are mutually orthogonal, so similarity cannot be expressed
answer.Bag-of-words: A vector of term counts that ignores word order
answer.TF-IDF: Term frequency scaled by rarity across the corpus, down-weighting ubiquitous words
answer.BM25: Probabilistic ranking with term-frequency saturation (k1) and length normalization (b)
